text:
Milo: heads-up — deploybot bumped a patch for my tiny log tweak (redwood-runtime). wondering if we should refine heuristics so nonfunctional churn doesn't flood patch tags.

Priya: what files did you touch? deploybot heuristics right now look for any changes under packages/* and infra/* so it's kinda blunt.

Milo: only a log line and removed an empty TODO in infra/telemetry/logger.js — 6 lines changed. no behavior change.

Lila: from docs side: we normally mark these as docs/chore and skip release notes. but tagging still happens and then folks expect release notes.

Jon: high level question — when should deploybot create a patch tag vs leave a PR untagged? we get noisy micro-patches that create release churn.

Sara-SRE: for customer-facing infra changes we want a patch and usually pin stable. for log-only, prefer no pin and skip user-facing release notes. metadata should capture that.

Priya: proposal: add a heuristic to deploybot: if diff_lines <= 8 AND files only match /(test|docs|.*logger.*|.*telemetry.*)/ then create tag but set meta=chore and do NOT auto-pin stable. Also add a release-note hint 'nonfunctional change — no user impact'.

DeployBot: @channel ReleaseBot detected candidate tag v0.42.7+buildmeta for package redwood-runtime from PR #4823. To approve: `/release approve 1735004321` or to approve+pin: `/release approve 1735004321 --pin stable`.

Milo: can we rename the `buildmeta` suffix? it's confusing. maybe `+chore` or `+ci` would be clearer in tags.

Priya: sure, we can map synonyms. backend rollout currently expects a `meta` key; display suffix is configurable. I'll prefer `+chore` for human readability.

Jon: we also need clear rollback rules tied to these heuristics. e.g., if it's meta=chore, don't trigger automatic rollback on small incident noise but do on clear functional regression (latency >5% or errors >1% sustained over 15m).

Sara-SRE: agree. For chore tags: set `rollback_policy=manual` unless a high-severity alert fires. For normal production patches keep `rollback_policy=auto` with thresholds.

Lila: I'll add a short release-note template and docs section that explains `[release-skip]` PR label and how `meta=chore` tags work so PMs and support know not to expect user-visible changes.

Milo: SGTM. Priya, want me to open the PR with test cases for small diffs?

Priya: please — small PR to deploybot rules + migration for old tags (`buildmeta` -> `chore`) would be ideal. I'll add an acceptance test for the 8-line cutoff and the file path regex.

Jon: +1 from me. Sara-SRE?

Sara-SRE: +1. also suggest a `shortwindow` option when approving pins so if someone accidentally pins we can auto-unpin after 2h unless extended.

Priya: noted — I'll include `--pin-duration` flag in the approve command and document defaults. thanks folks.

Milo: thanks — that'll reduce noisy patches.
